name: herdr-office
description: Pixel office GUI orchestrator for Herdr agents

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w server && tsx test-e2e.ts
